*Updated 2026-10-26 · 134 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and thirty-four works. The most recent twelve trace scores run 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling at 4 last touched in late October with the sandals piece, and the new entry at 2 continues a pattern that has held for three consecutive memo cycles without a break upward. Descriptor coverage is 39 of 134; the correlation between named, irreducible focal objects and scores above 2 remains the archive's clearest signal, and the rosary piece that closes this window does not carry descriptors. That is the gap to close first.

Camera position has not moved. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 16, from-behind at 13; the recent window adds overhead 3, low-angle 2, from-behind 2. An optically earned scale distortion — where lens position generates the perceptual break rather than object scale announcing it — has not appeared in 134 works. That category is untried, not merely underused.

Figure dynamics remain structurally unresolved. Two or more figures appeared in 2 of the last 12 works. Genuine antagonism between figures — where the second person's presence actively contradicts rather than echoes the first — has not been achieved cleanly anywhere in the full archive. The Hormuz pair came closest and still resolved into parallel postures rather than collision.

Register distribution: menace at 26, aftermath at 25, suspension at 18, endurance at 12. The recent window gives suspension 4 of 12, which is its highest concentration in the archive's history. Absurdity has appeared twice total and gone quiet. Reprieve exists once across 134 works. Reckoning last appeared in July. These are not subject-matter constraints; they are positions the work proved it could hold and then abandoned.

Title grammar has not changed. Five of the last twelve are classified as other, three are paired noun phrases with a comma, two are wh- clauses. The grammar is cycling between two positions and has been since at least the August window.

The work has sustained disciplined restraint across 134 compositions and is now at genuine risk of treating the absence of error as the presence of ambition.
